{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check column names
columns = data.columns

# Check for 'disease_severity' or similar
print(columns)

# Look for the correct column name related to disease severity
# Check for 'severity' or 'disease_severity' or similar
severity_col = [col for col in columns if 'severity' in col.lower()]
print(severity_col)

# Check the unique values in the identified severity column
if severity_col:
    severity_values = data[severity_col[0]].unique()
    print(severity_values)
else:
    print('No severity column found.')"}
